name: leibniz-stepped-reckoner
description: Leibniz's stepped reckoner, the first calculating machine for all four operations of arithmetic, as an interactive 3D simulator in the browser.

scripts.build:model: pnpm build:model:m0 && pnpm build:model:m1 && pnpm build:model:m2
scripts.check:model: "${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender}" --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python blender/scripts/check_m0_clearance.py && pnpm poses:m1 && "${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender}" --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python blender/scripts/check_m1_clearance.py && pnpm poses:m2 && "${BLENDER:-/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender}" --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python blender/scripts/check_m2_clearance.py
